items.html: And on Yom Kippur, her ten Sefirot were already sawed from the eve of Yom Kippur. Therefore, at the beginning of the night of this day, she ascends level after level to the Supernal Ima, in the order of the five prayers; and at the repetition of the Musaf, her ascent there is completed. And the matter of her ascent there is in the secret of "And the Lord God built the rib," etc. For there she adorns herself with ornaments, and takes the five Gevurot from Ima herself, without the agency of ZA, as it was until now on Rosh HaShanah. And in the Ne'ilah closing prayer the seal of her Yesod, which is the vessel in which the Mayin Nukvin are placed, namely the five Gevurot she took from Ima, is also made. And it has already been explained above that this seal is not her Yesod itself.
